Info

Factory service constructing ScaraDecompiler instances.

class scaralang.core.service.decompiler.scara_decompiler_factory.ScaraDecompilerFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing instantiation of ScaraDecompiler service.

It defines:

methods:
create - Instantiates configured ScaraDecompiler.
create_default - Instantiates ScaraDecompiler with standard defaults.
get_version - Returns factory version string.
classmethod create(*, parser: IBinaryFrameParser, frame_decompiler: IFrameDecompiler) → ScaraDecompiler[source]¶

Instantiates configured ScaraDecompiler service.

Parameters:

  • parser – Required IBinaryFrameParser implementation.

  • frame_decompiler – Required IFrameDecompiler implementation.

Returns:

Fully configured ScaraDecompiler instance.

Exceptions:

None.
